chunks: This saying has appeared earlier as well, but here it contains a beautiful and useful addition.

key_terms.السَّيِّدُ الرِّضَىٰ: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī (a title for the scholar who compiled/edited Nahj al-Balagha)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the additional content in this narration compared to earlier mentions?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Raḍī highlights this passage as a distinct, beneficial addition to his earlier discourse, reflecting his meticulous editorial approach in *Nahj al-Balagha* where he curates sermons, letters, and sayings to emphasize specific theological nuances. This meta-commentary underscores the scholarly tradition of viewing the Imam’s words not as static repetitions, but as layered teachings where context and emphasis shift to address different dimensions of divine wisdom and human conduct.
